title: Define Coder and complete READY package in governing instructions
outcome: Define Coder and complete READY package in governing instructions
acceptance: Governing Markdown defines Coder and complete READY handoff/package, or explicitly maps them to existing implementer and worker-delivered patch terminology, including the validation and complete review evidence required before handoff.
Any resulting authority text change follows the existing concurrence, Greg-notice, final-diff audit and applicable validation/review process.
